title: Feyospace-v1: How the Cyber Mercury Seven Trained Frontier Cyber Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.08418v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Training capable cyber agents is often treated primarily as a problem of model scale, yet open-weight post-training is constrained more directly by the cost of executable environments, reliable multi-turn supervision, and access to strong teachers. We present a data-centric framework that addresses these bottlenecks through five complementary systems: Choulea analyzes hidden reasoning signatures, SkyReal reduces teacher-sampling cost, Hongzwang bypasses API restrictions on teacher execution, PSBreakup restores capabilities weakened by model merging, and Kreator converts expert interventions into trainable reasoning. Our data engine constructs resettable coding, vulnerability, CTF, kernel-history, full-exploit, firmware, and device-backed environments. translated_title: Feyospace-v1：网络“水星七杰”如何训练前沿网络安全模型
translated_abstract: 训练能力强大的网络安全智能体通常被主要视为模型规模问题，然而开放权重的后训练更直接地受到可执行环境成本、可靠多轮监督以及获取强大教师模型的制约。我们提出了一个以数据为中心的框架，通过五个互补系统来解决这些瓶颈：Choulea分析隐藏的推理特征，SkyReal降低教师采样成本，Hongzwang绕过教师执行上的API限制，PSBreakup恢复因模型合并而削弱的能力，Kreator将专家干预转化为可训练的推理。我们的数据引擎构建了可重置的代码、漏洞、CTF、内核历史、完整漏洞利用、固件以及设备支持的环境。候选轨迹只有在经过执行验证和证据审计后才会被保留，最终产出了164,269条用于长上下文监督微调的轨迹。这三个检查点……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出以数据为中心的Feyospace-v1框架，通过五个互补系统（隐藏推理分析、教师采样降本、API限制绕过、模型合并能力恢复、专家干预转化）与可重置的网络安全执行环境，经执行验证与证据审计生成164,269条高质量轨迹，突破开放权重网络安全智能体后训练在环境成本、监督质量与教师获取上的瓶颈。
en_tdlr: Feyospace-v1 is a data-centric framework that uses five complementary data systems and resettable cyber environments to produce 164,269 execution-verified trajectories, overcoming open-weight post-training bottlenecks in environment cost, multi-turn supervision, and teacher access for frontier cyber agents.
